s.en: Red, blue, green, black and white chromatic dragons (young / adult / ancient). They have legendary resistance, legendary actions, frightful presence and breath weapons, and are the endgame foes of adventurer levels. When off, none of the events below appear.

s.en: A young or adult dragon (white dragons don't extort) lands at the map edge demanding tribute: pay, parley or refuse. Needs the colony's highest adventurer level ≥8.
